groups.activity: crack relics, sell Prime parts at a Relay Ducat Kiosk

rows.label: Orokin Ducats
rows.note: common 15, uncommon 45, rare 100; 25 or 65 for parts demoted after a vaulting

conditions: Varzia sells Ducats for Aya at 5 per Aya; players call the rate terrible, so crack relics instead.
bonuses: Capture and Exterminate on fast tilesets, or Defense (relic swaps every wave and more relic drops); Nova, Mirage or Gara speed up Defense.
Intact Meso D8 and Neo X1 have a 45-Ducat part in the common slot.
A pile of duplicate Prime parts usually covers 410 on its own.

disclosures.title: endless options
disclosures.body: Void Cascade with a competent group and Void Flood are the other popular picks. Radiant relics raise your gold odds, and a full squad of 4 gives far more Ducat-worthy picks than solo.

groups.activity: buy it the visit it shows up
groups.meta: every two weeks for 48 hours; stock rotates

rows.label: Machete Wraith
rows.note: arrives built, no blueprint or foundry step

conditions: Only stocked on some visits and can go many months between appearances.
Don't confuse it with the Prisma Machete (400 Ducats + 200,000 cr); only the Wraith covers this target.
A Machete Wraith handed out by a Duviri loadout doesn't join your arsenal or give Mastery.

disclosures.title: finding his next visit
disclosures.body: The Ducat Kiosk in any Relay shows Baro's countdown and next Relay; typing "when baro" in Region chat also answers. The TennoCon Baro Relay (normally July, open for a week) carries his entire catalog to anyone holding Baro's Relay Ticket from the digital TennoCon ticket. It is tradeable, so another player can sell you one.
